scenes.title: Harvard Memorial Hall & Red-Brick Yard Cutaway into Photography Darkroom
scenes.era: 2002 Harvard University Department of Psychology & Photography Darkroom

layout.description: Sunlit Ruskinian Gothic red-brick Harvard Memorial Hall tower slicing open into a warm photography darkroom with an optical enlarger, three white porcelain trays, hanging black-and-white silver prints, and oak worktables.

positions.where: standing beside the darkroom oak counter holding two framed silver prints
weighing two framed black-and-white prints beneath warm safelight
positions.facing: toward the two prints on the oak table

props.name: Two framed black-and-white silver gelatin prints
props.period_detail: Student-printed 8x10 photographs from the Harvard darkroom course
props.physical_behavior: one print is packed home while the second stays behind on the lab counter

props.name: Photographic darkroom optical enlarger and developing trays
props.period_detail: Classic analog darkroom apparatus with brass lens bellows and tongs
props.physical_behavior: projects crisp negative light onto photographic paper before chemical bath

actions.verb_sequence: lifts both framed prints side by side -> hands one print back -> carries chosen frame into dorm

reactions.reaction: squints anxiously at tiny corners of the framed print while glancing back toward the door

scenes.wardrobe: Corduroy academic blazer for researcher and collegiate knit sweater over collared shirt for student.
scenes.lighting: Crisp Cambridge morning sunlight outside contrasting with warm amber-red safelight and tungsten desk lamps inside.
scenes.recognition_hook: Harvard psychologists had photography students print two favorite photos and gave half a five-day window to swap their pick.

key_visual.description: Harvard Memorial Hall facade cutaway revealing photography darkroom enlarger and two framed prints.

scenes.title: 3D Borosilicate Glass Brain — Anterior Cingulate Conflict & Prefrontal Value Synthesis

layout.description: Deep obsidian museum void housing a translucent frosted borosilicate crystal brain with crimson-red anterior cingulate arch and warm amber-gold prefrontal ridges.

positions.where: centered in 9:16 frame for B0->B1 macro FPV dives

props.name: Translucent Borosilicate Crystal Brain Model
props.period_detail: Zero-flesh optical glass cortical folds and internal subcortical chambers
props.physical_behavior: crimson cingulate conflict pulses yield to warm amber-gold prefrontal glow once choice locks

actions.verb_sequence: dives through frosted cortical glass into ACC arch -> pulls back to dorm -> dives into prefrontal cortex ridges

reactions.reaction: illuminate in steady warm amber-gold light as commitment closes

scenes.lighting: Rim-lit optical crystal caustics over clean dark obsidian studio backdrop.
scenes.recognition_hook: Closing an escape hatch shifts brain activity from anterior cingulate conflict auditing to prefrontal value building.
